result.detail: Out of scope here, and recorded so that nothing is assumed. The expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, so I submitted no formal_spec (.sby). The formal.run and formal.cover requirements therefore do not apply to this submission. The interface spec's formal requirement (section 6) and the microarchitecture plan's rr_arbiter.sby / rr_arbiter_n5.sby are still open; the assertions are already in the RTL under FORMAL. The failure-path testbench rr_arbiter_tb_fail.v from the microarchitecture plan is also not included. Both should be tracked as follow-up work, or added to this task if the tech lead (design.rtl.design.tech_lead) wants them here. The testbench has no `timescale, so it cannot cause a TIMESCALEMOD mismatch with the RTL. It indexes arrays and bits only through exact-width part-selects or shifts, to avoid Verilator WIDTH warnings. An independent review record is still required after the platform checks.
